Red Rescue Team and Blue Rescue Team]] title theme | colspan=2 | ''[[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Team Go-Getters Out of the Gate!]]'' |- | colspan="4" style="background:#3467af; {{roundybottom|5px}}" | |} ==Trivia== * Starting with [[We Will Be Heroes]], the {{pkmn|animated series}} opening themes started to include credits. * A version of the opening theme for each season also serves as the ending theme for that season: ** From [[S01|Pokémon: Indigo League]] (starting from ''[[EP052|Princess vs. Princess]]'') till [[S08|Pokémon: Advanced Battle]], a shortened version of the opening theme with vocals is used. The ending animation consists of a split screen with scenes from the opening theme on one side and the credits on a black background on the other side. ** For [[S09|Pokémon: Battle Frontier]], part of the rap section of {{so|Pokémon Go!}} served as the ending theme, played with the credits being shown over a black background. ** From [[S10|Pokémon: Diamond and Pearl]] onwards, an instrumental version of the opening theme is used as the ending theme. Till [[Pokémon the Series: XYZ]], the ending animation consisted of the credits over a black background. ** [[S17|Pokémon the Series: XY]] used a different instrumental in the credits. ** From [[S20|Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon]] onwards, the ending animation features scenes from the corresponding Japanese ending theme. ** In the Asian release of the English dub of [[Pokémon Horizons: Season 2—The Search for Laqua]], the instrumental version of [[My Favorite Pokémon]] is replaced as the ending theme with [[Make You Shine|Make You Shine (English Ver.)]]. ** In the Asian release of the English dub of [[Pokémon Horizons: Season 3—Rising Hope]], the instrumental version of [[Evolving Again]] is replaced as the ending theme with [[Ready Go]]. ==Related articles== {{English opening themes}}
